chapters.label: Wembley, live
chapters.text: Wembley, 2013, the Champions League final: Bayern in red, Dortmund in yellow, one-all, last minute. Arjen Robben has missed two chances. A long ball, Ribéry's back-heel, and Robben runs through... goal!

chapters.label: Into the space
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Robben keeps running into the space between defenders. The ball bounces off one, and he's free.

chapters.label: The calm finish
chapters.text: Keeper Weidenfeller rushes out. Robben stays calm and pokes it early with his left foot. It rolls in, slowly... Bayern win!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: missed a chance? Stay brave. Keep running into space, and when the chance comes, finish calmly.
